test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Harnaaz Kaur Sandhu is an Indian model and beauty pageant titleholder who was crowned ______ 2021.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Miss Universe**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Harnaaz Kaur Sandhu has been crowned Miss Universe 2021 and is the third entrant from India to win Miss Universe.
 
• Sandhu became the first ever Sikh woman who won the title of Miss Universe.
 
• Sandhu has also crowned Femina Miss India Punjab in 2019.
 
• List of other Miss Universe from India:
 
 
• Sushmita Sen: 1994
 
• Lara Dutta: 2000
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• R'Bonney Gabriel from the US was named the winner of the 71st annual Miss Universe pageant on 15 January 2023. 
 
• In second place was Miss Venezuela Amanda Dudamel, followed by Miss Dominican Republic Andreína Martínez.
 
• She is also the first Filipina American to win Miss USA.
 
• This year’s Miss Universe pageant allowed married women and mothers to compete for the first time in its 70-year history.
